# Perform basic analyses, output figures and tables for Temperature, Salinity, Dissolved Oxygen data

``` {r BasicStats}
# Temperature
Temp_daily <- TSDO_clean %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(DateTimeStamp)) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Date) %>%
  summarise(
    Temp_mean = if (all(is.na(Temp))) NA_real_ else mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temp_min  = if (all(is.na(Temp))) NA_real_ else min(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temp_max  = if (all(is.na(Temp))) NA_real_ else max(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Salinity
Sal_daily <- TSDO_clean %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(DateTimeStamp)) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Date) %>%
  summarise(
    Sal_mean = if (all(is.na(Sal))) NA_real_ else mean(Sal, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sal_min  = if (all(is.na(Sal))) NA_real_ else min(Sal, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sal_max  = if (all(is.na(Sal))) NA_real_ else max(Sal, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Dissolved Oxygen
DO_pct_daily <- TSDO_clean %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(DateTimeStamp)) %>%
  group_by(StationCode, Date) %>%
  summarise(
    DO_pct_mean = if (all(is.na(DO_pct))) NA_real_ else mean(DO_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    DO_pct_min  = if (all(is.na(DO_pct))) NA_real_ else min(DO_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    DO_pct_max  = if (all(is.na(DO_pct))) NA_real_ else max(DO_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )



```
